name: frontend-design
description: >-
  Make the Pawse UI distinctive and demo-ready instead of generic: consistent tokens, typography, visible
  agent progress, a hero moment. Use when someone asks to "make it look good", "polish the UI",
  "design the demo screen", or before the pitch.
---

# Frontend design

Judges remember one screen. Design that screen; keep the rest clean. The UI lives in `pawse/static/`
(`index.html`, `style.css`, `app.js`, `voice.js`; plain HTML/CSS/JS, no build step).

## 1. Respect the concept

Pawse is Mapify-inspired pink/gray (see [docs/AGENT_DEVELOPMENT.md](../../../docs/AGENT_DEVELOPMENT.md)).
Write one line in the commit before big changes: *"Feels <adjective>, the hero moment is <what reveals>."*

## 2. Tokens, not ad-hoc values

Colors live as custom properties in `:root` of `pawse/static/style.css` (`--ink`, `--muted`, `--green`
(the pink accent), `--paper`, `--line`, ...). Use them everywhere; add a token rather than a hex literal.
Type: one display font + one text font, big size contrast. Check `prefers-color-scheme: dark`.

## 3. Make the agents visible

- The agent run as a live timeline (status icon, agent name, short human label), not raw JSON.
- Show a "working" state within 200 ms of submit; stream results as they arrive.
- Clinic cards, cited policy clauses and the German script with subtitles as structured cards.
- Every simulated step carries a visible "simulated" label.

## 4. Polish (only after the story works)

- One entrance animation for the hero result, 150-300 ms, ease-out. No looping decoration.
- Keyboard and touch both complete the story; focus states visible; text never via `innerHTML` from untrusted data.
- Projector check: 1280x720, 125% zoom, readable from the back of the room. Narrow mobile width too.

## Anti-patterns

Gradient blobs, glassmorphism everywhere, emoji as core icons, six font sizes, centered body text,
lorem ipsum in the demo, tiny gray text on gray.

## Keep this skill current

Update the token list when `style.css` changes. Run `python scripts/validate_skills.py` after editing.

# Pawse main page (`/`): drop the demo/hackathon look, ship a production-style page

## Context
Ari wants `/` (`pawse/static/`) to read like a real product, not a hackathon demo: no "Hackathon prototype",
no Mimi rehearsal as the first thing you see, no synthetic "DEMO POLICY", no internal agent/dev panels
("Team owner: llm", "configured not verified", raw lat/lng). They want it to feel *live*, but honestly
(rule 3: nothing simulated may look real), and not cringe (no fake user counts, no "AI-powered ✨").

## Approach: one page, two modes
- **Default `/`** = the real product: hero → care request → results → voice studio.
- **`/?demo=1`** = everything demo-only (Mimi rehearsal, synthetic policy, agent graph, legacy CatAgent).
  Same convention the React app already uses (`/app/?demo=1`). Rehearsal stays reachable as the keyless
  fallback, so the golden path isn't lost; its "simulated" labels stay untouched there.
- Implementation: wrap those sections in `class="demo-only"`, CSS `body:not(.demo-mode) .demo-only{display:none}`,
  a 2-line script in `app.js` adds `demo-mode` when `URLSearchParams` has `demo`. All IDs stay, so
  `app.js`/`voice.js` fetches keep working with no null-element crashes. (In default mode, skip the
  `/api/v1/agents/graph`, `/knowledge/policy`, `/capabilities` fetches to avoid pointless calls.)

## Changes, `pawse/static/index.html` (+ small `style.css`, `app.js`)
1. **Title**: `Pawse · Care help for your cat` (no em dash).
2. **Sidebar**: nav = Care now · Nearby vets · My voice · Phone assistant. Mimi's story / Insurance /
   My cat's agent links get `demo-only`. Footer "Built for Tech Europe / Hackathon prototype · MIT" →
   the live status line (below).
3. **Live, honestly**: a small status chip in the header, replacing "● YOUR CAT'S CARE COMPANION" and
   "editable location": green dot + `Online · Zurich` when `GET /api/v1/health` is ok; if voice profile
   reports Gemini/Gradium missing, amber dot + `Limited: voice unavailable`; red `Offline` on fetch fail.
   Driven only by real endpoints, re-checked every 60 s. No counters, no pulsing gimmicks beyond a subtle dot.
4. **Hero**: drop the ASCII cat (`▲ ▲ / • ᴥ •`) and "Meet Mimi's care team"; CTAs = `Start a care request`
   (→ #care) and `Set up my voice`. Tighten copy, drop the "LET'S TAKE THE NEXT STEP, TOGETHER" eyebrow.
5. **Reorder**: care form + results come right after the hero (the core job), voice studio after.
6. **Voice section**: remove vendor pill "GEMINI + GRADIUM" and badges "01 / …" numbering stays minimal;
   service-status line kept (it's real) but restyled as the same dot pattern. Footnote shortened to one
   honest line: "Pawse prepares the script and audio. It doesn't place phone calls."
7. **Care form**:
   - Hide the dev toggle "Coordinate my care with the agent workflow…" (keep the input, checked, `hidden`).
   - Lat/Lng/Radius move into a collapsed `<details>` "Adjust search area"; visible line stays
     "Searching near Zurich city centre · Use my location".
   - "Target: under a minute. Partial results…" → "Pawse never books care or calls anyone for you."
   - Section counters "01 / Tell us", "02 / Take action" removed.
8. **Results**: agent trace panel shown only in demo mode (in default mode the progress line is enough);
   keep the "Some services were unavailable" warning (honest partial results).
9. **Footer**: keep the disclaimer + privacy line; drop "API documentation · Source code"; add a quiet
   `Demo walkthrough` link to `/?demo=1`.

## Docs (same change, per AGENTS.md "docs match the code")
- `AGENTS.md` golden-path note: rehearsal is now at `/?demo=1`, not the first screen.
- `.claude/skills/demo-check/SKILL.md` and `docs/VALIDATION.md` if they say "first screen" (grep, update).

## Not touched
`web/` (Ari's uncommitted edits live there), `pawse/app.py`, API contract, backend.

## Verification
- `bash scripts/check.sh` (secret scan, JS syntax, contract, pytest).
- `PAWSE_E2E=1 python -m pytest tests/e2e/test_browser_layout.py tests/e2e/test_browser_upload.py`
  (no horizontal scroll / no overlap on `/`; voice IDs unchanged).
- Run uvicorn on a free port, screenshot `/` and `/?demo=1` at 1280 and 390 px; check console has no

I fixed it in a new PR. The failing test was hiding a real problem: the public phone app was playing a scripted conversation with nothing saying it was simulated.

**PR:** https://github.com/yyyuanfish/pawse/pull/66 (open, not merged)

**What was wrong**
- The public "Live Demo" link (`/app/`) has been running the **scripted** voice, clinic and phone agents. The Dockerfile builds the app without any `VITE_*` settings, and `web/src/config.js` falls back to the scripted agents in that case. I confirmed this in the deployed bundle.
- 🛑 #56 removed the only "Demo mode · scripted" badge. So owners on the public URL saw a scripted conversation with no simulated label, which breaks rule 3.
- #63 then rewrote the test to only check that a "Simulated rehearsal" link exists in settings. I ran it on main and it passes without anything being fixed.

**The fix**
- A plain `/app/` now uses the real backend by default, which docker-compose already did. The scripted agents only run with `?demo=1` or an explicit `VITE_*=mock` setting.
- Whenever anything is scripted, a "Simulated rehearsal · scripted, no real calls or bookings" bar shows at the top of every screen. The production `/app/` has no badge, which is what #56 was going for.
- I wrote the tests first and watched them fail:
  - a browser test that checks the bar is on screen at `/app/?demo=1` (home and call screens) and absent on `/app/`;
  - a small Node check (`web/scripts/check-config.mjs`) that a build without settings uses the live agents.

**5 more browser tests were also failing on main.** They were outdated, not product bugs, so I fixed them in the same PR:
- 3 own-voice tests didn't open the settings section that #63 moved the button into.
- The live tool-call test didn't expect the `insurance` field #56 added.
- The denied-microphone test matched two error lines instead of one.

**Results:** `bash scripts/check.sh` passes (170 tests). All browser tests pass: 80 passed, 10 skipped, compared with 5 failing on main.

⚠️ Once this is deployed, the public `/app/` link uses real Gemini calls and counts against your quota. The scripted Mimi story moves to `/app/?demo=1`.

⚠️ While the browser tests ran with no keys, the call screen showed owners "Set GRADIUM_API_KEY in the local .env and restart". That's a developer message, and I didn't change it here.

⚠️ PR #57 (the main-page cleanup) is based on an older main, and both PRs edit `AGENTS.md`. Whichever merges second may need a quick rebase.

The work is in `/home/azureuser/pawse-wt/app-simulated-label`. The demo-mode screenshot is at `/tmp/claude-1000/-home-azureuser-pawse/0b2d55a1-3e1b-49b7-a95a-553ee725efad/scratchpad/app-demo.png`.
